subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should this umbrella be split into separate TUI default-session, sessions_send channel-routing, WeChat plugin/core routing, background-event isolation, and activity-ordering work items, and which owner boundary should own each?
rationale: Current source confirms unresolved pieces, but the report crosses core TUI/Gateway session semantics, an external WeChat plugin boundary, sessions_send routing, and product-level background-event/activity semantics.

options.title: Split and route subproblems
options.body: Keep the already-open focused issues for meaningful activity and sessions_send, then create targeted maintainer-owned follow-ups for the remaining TUI, WeChat proof, and event-isolation pieces.

options.title: Keep one umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the tracking issue and block automation until maintainers can reproduce the WeChat and flood/deadlock paths live.

options.title: Close only after focused fixes land
options.body: Close this issue later when linked focused issues or PRs cover each reported behavior with current-main or shipped proof.

recommendation.title: Split and route subproblems
recommendation.body: Keep the already-open focused issues for meaningful activity and sessions_send, then create targeted maintainer-owned follow-ups for the remaining TUI, WeChat proof, and event-isolation pieces.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans session UX, TUI behavior, Gateway routing, and WeChat docs/product boundaries, where steipete is the strongest combined history signal available in this checkout.
